Name: 18ft x 33ft Oval Shape Rockwood On Groud Pool Kit no Step
Natural: 18' x 33' Oval Shape Rockwood On Groud Pool is the ultimate in backyard fun! Simply designed and elegantly placed these pools enhance the style of your backyard. The pool trimmed with an elegant deck retaining walls or fencing. From a clean and simple Rockwood round shape to an impressive kidney shape we have what a growing family needs to play in. Rockwood didn t invent the vinyl-lined pool but the engineers did have the good sense to re-think it! A reengineered approach to On Ground/Semi-Inground pool design and construction starting from the bottom up. Examining the forces and factors affecting a traditional pool built on grade at a variety of challenging sites and made improvements wherever any weaknesses were found. Resulting in manufacturing innovations that have led to more options in what was previously a very limited market in pool sizes and shapes. The Rockwood is so well engineered they can be installed totally above grade or in-ground.
